cohort_rules: Identical to v2: age 18-79, positive fasting weight, sex 1/2, >=2 valid paired SBP readings, five finite positive features, design variables present, no imputation
primary_population: api_accepted: eligible participants whose five inputs lie inside the published metadata field bounds
primary_metric: weighted_mae of the frozen selected model (fasting weight WTSAF2YR)
nn_superiority_rule: Claim only if the 95% bootstrap interval of (MLP - Ridge) weighted MAE lies entirely below 0

conformal.calibration_set: v2 internal test split (n=497), never used for training or selection
conformal.quantile_rule: finite-sample: k = ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)) order statistic; asymmetric uses alpha/2 per tail
conformal.calibration_weighting: unweighted (exchangeability); coverage reported unweighted and weighted
conformal.display_rule: Show primary interval in the application only if external unweighted coverage on the primary population >= 0.85
